facts.fact: The pass-village watcher found every Resin House scent-post gone cold at once and forty horses' dung on the goat path; Vellan met Kesu's grandson coming down it.
Neela read 'Sell to the crown when spent' on Vellan's leaf and took it as Chathu's threat to one man, not a trade; the 'Sold to the crown' sheet confirms the scale and pattern.
The thirty pages went to Kodiyur in a green-sealed box, and the sales ran over twenty years with rising sums.
Pepper hunters cut wild vine from the gullies in the dry months and use the shelter.
Kamalakshi laughs for the first time at the shelter.
